newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia auctions 0.72 pct Sibneft Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: Russia auctions 0.72 pct Sibneft Dec 27.

text.p: Russia will auction 32.52 million shares or 0.72 percent of the capital of Sibirskaya Neftynaya Kompaniya (Sibneft) with bids accepted from November 27 to December 27, the Federal Securities Corporation said on Monday.
Results of the auction will be announced on December 30, it said in a statement.
The shares, with a face value of 1.60 roubles, have a starting price of 400 roubles, putting a minimum price of 13 billion roubles on the entire lot.
Shares in Sibneft are not actively traded. Sibneft is one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years. Its main operating unit is Noyabrskneftegaz.
Foreigners are allowed to bid in the auction, as the limit on foreign investment in Sibneft is 15 percent, Sergei Andreyev, deputy head of the corporation's cash auctions department, told Reuters.
